verdict.rationale: Square exposes an llms.txt file and an official MCP server (developer.squareup.com/docs/mcp), which lets AI agents interact with Square's APIs via natural-language-driven tool calls, giving some agentic/NL operability. However, there's no evidence of a built-in conversational or NL command interface for end users operating Square itself (e.g., a chat-based POS/dashboard assistant) — the evidence is developer/API-tooling oriented, not a consumer-facing NL command layer. Missing for 10: native NL command UI for merchants/end-users, hands-on evidence of MCP server actually driving real operations, and independent corroboration beyond the docs probe.
